title: A novel imidazo[1,2-a]pyridine derivative and its co-administration with curcumin exert anti-inflammatory effects by modulating the STAT3/NF-kappaB/iNOS/COX-2 signaling pathway in breast and ovarian cancer cell lines.
authors: Afshari, Havva; Noori, Shokoofe; Nourbakhsh, Mitra; Daraei, Azam; Azami Movahed, Mahsa; Zarghi, Afshin
one_liner_zh: 该文研究咪唑并吡啶衍生物与姜黄素通过STAT3/NF-kB通路发挥抗炎作用，虽含分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作核心，方法浅层且无AI/物理模拟创新。
abstract: INTRODUCTION: Imidazo[1,2-a]pyridine derivatives with diverse pharmacological properties and curcumin, as a potential natural anti-inflammatory compound, are promising compounds for cancer treatment. This study aimed to synthesize a novel imidazo[1,2-a]pyridine derivative, (MIA), and evaluate its anti-inflammatory activity and effects on nuclear factor-kappaB (NF-kappaB) and signal transducer and activator of transcription 3 (STAT3) pathways, and their target genes, alone and in combination with curcumin, in MDA-MB-231 and SKOV3 cell lines. METHODS: We evaluated the interaction between imidazo[1,2-a]pyridine ligand, curcumin, and NF-kappaB p50 protein, using molecular docking studies. MTT assay was used to investigate the impacts of compounds on cell viability. To evaluate the NF-kappaB DNA binding activity and the level of inflammatory cytokines in response to the compounds, ELISA-based methods were performed. In addition, quantitative polymerase chain reaction (qPCR) and western blotting were carried out to analyze the expression of genes and investigate NF-kappaB and STAT3 signaling pathways. RESULTS: Molecular docking studies showed that MIA docked into the NF-kappaB p50 subunit, and curcumin augmented its binding. The MTT assay results indicated that MIA and its combination with curcumin reduced cell viability. According to the results of the ELISA-based methods, MIA lowered the levels of inflammatory cytokines and suppressed NF-kappaB activity. In addition, real-time PCR and Griess test results showed that the expression of cyclooxygenase-2 (COX-2) and inducible NO synthase (iNOS) genes, and nitrite production were reduced by MIA. Furthermore, the western blotting analysis demonstrated that MIA increased the expression of inhibitory kappaB (IkappaBalpha) and B-cell lymphoma 2 (Bcl-2)-associated X proteins (BAX), and suppressed the STAT3 phosphorylation, and Bcl-2 expression. Our findings revealed that curcumin had a potentiating role and enhanced all the anti-inflammatory effects of MIA. CONCLUSION: This study indicated that the anti-inflammatory activity of MIA is exerted by suppressing the NF-kappaB and STAT3 signaling pathways in MDA-MB-231 and SKOV3 cancer cell lines.
abstract_zh: 引言：具有多种药理特性的咪唑并[1,2-a]吡啶衍生物和姜黄素作为一种潜在的天然抗炎化合物，是治疗癌症的有前景的化合物。本研究旨在合成一种新型咪唑并[1,2-a]吡啶衍生物（MIA），并评估其单独及与姜黄素联合使用时，在MDA-MB-231和SKOV3细胞系中的抗炎活性及其对核因子-κB（NF-kappaB）和信号转导与转录激活因子3（STAT3）通路及其靶基因的影响。方法：我们利用分子对接研究评估了咪唑并[1,2-a]吡啶配体、姜黄素和NF-kappaB p50蛋白之间的相互作用。采用MTT法检测化合物对细胞活力的影响。为评估NF-kappaB DNA结合活性和炎症细胞因子水平对化合物的响应，采用了基于ELISA的方法。此外，进行了定量聚合酶链反应（qPCR）和蛋白质印迹分析，以分析基因表达并研究NF-kappaB和STAT3信号通路。结果：分子对接研究表明，MIA对接入NF-kappaB p50亚基，且姜黄素增强了其结合。MTT法结果显示，MIA及其与姜黄素的联合使用降低了细胞活力。基于ELISA方法的结果表明，MIA降低了炎症细胞因子水平并抑制了NF-kappaB活性。此外，实时PCR和Griess试验结果显示，MIA降低了环氧合酶-2（COX-2）和诱导型一氧化氮合酶（iNOS）基因的表达以及亚硝酸盐的产生。进一步地，蛋白质印迹分析表明，MIA增加了抑制性κB（IkappaBalpha）和B细胞淋巴瘤2（Bcl-2）相关X蛋白（BAX）的表达，并抑制了STAT3磷酸化和Bcl-2表达。我们的发现表明，姜黄素具有增强作用，并增强了MIA的所有抗炎效果。结论：本研究指出，MIA的抗炎活性是通过抑制MDA-MB-231和SKOV3癌细胞系中的NF-kappaB和STAT3信号通路来实现的。
